purpose: Teach: 悪党/対局/貧血/中性/土砂/憂い/ぞっと/手遅れ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、悪党、絶対、まがいの、絶対、競合、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Watch our competitors in the industry carefully. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Direct, measured command. Slight weight on 「注視しろ」. Even tone, no room for interpretation. The kind of attention that expects results, not questions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の、本気で、絶対、対局、絶対、的な、絶対、二極化、絶対、当社、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. The market is polarizing sharply, and we're adapting to it accordingly.
lines.style: Calm, professional confirmation. Steady delivery. Each point lands with quiet competence. No flourish — just the facts, and the implied confidence behind them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の、本気で、絶対、貧血、絶対、対策、絶対、健康管理、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need you to strengthen our health and safety protocols for the staff. This matters.
lines.style: Serious, slightly elevated. Firmness on the directive. Pauses for weight. Not harsh — but unmistakably non-negotiable. The tone of someone who's seen what happens when you don't act.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の、本気で、絶対、中性、絶対、洗剤、絶対、ライン、絶対、好評です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our neutral detergent line is performing well. We're pleased with the results.
lines.style: Straightforward update, delivered with quiet satisfaction. Moderate pace. The slight warmth of reporting good news without over-celebrating it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、土砂、絶対、災害、絶対、当社、絶対、支援を、絶対、惜しむな、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Support the region hit by the landslide disaster. Don't hold back. I need this done.
lines.style: Sharp, resolute command. Emphasis on the action. Tone carries both moral weight and expectation of immediate execution. Not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、憂い、絶対、寄り添える、絶対、職場づくり、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're building a workplace where employees feel supported through their difficulties.
lines.style: Steady, earnest confirmation. Warmth underneath the formality. Pace is thoughtful. The tone of someone reporting something they genuinely believe matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、ぞっと、絶対、する、絶対、不祥事、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Stay vigilant about scandals in our industry. Watch for signs. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Alert, intent focus. Slight edge to the tone — the urgency of prevention rather than reaction. Measured but with underlying gravity. A warning delivered with respect.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。対応が、本気で、絶対、手遅れ、絶対、にならぬよう、絶対、リスク管理、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're being thorough with risk management so we don't let response times slip.
lines.style: Final confirmation, confident closure. Steady, professional delivery. Slight emphasis on thoroughness. The tone of someone wrapping up with the assurance that nothing has been left to chance.
